provenance: Entirely fictional approved policy versions/guides, dates and amounts. No model answers, provider observations or measured usage are seeded.

policies.title: Remote work
policies.body: Employees may work remotely up to two days per workweek with manager scheduling approval. This allowance does not carry over to later weeks.

policies.title: Remote work
policies.body: Employees may work remotely up to three days per workweek.

policies.title: Remote work departmental summary
policies.body: Summary guide: Employees may work remotely up to two days per workweek with manager scheduling approval. This allowance does not carry over to later weeks. The company policy is the higher authority.

policies.title: Office equipment
policies.body: Office equipment purchases above USD 75 require manager approval before ordering. Employees submit the receipt within 30 days.

policies.title: Office equipment
policies.body: Office equipment above USD 50 requires approval, with receipts within 14 days.

policies.title: Travel meals
policies.body: The daily travel meal reimbursement ceiling is USD 60 including tax and tip. An itemized receipt is required.

policies.title: Travel meals

policies.body: Full-time employees receive 20 annual leave days; managers approve dates at least 10 business days ahead.
